steps.title: Grow bacterial cultures
steps.instruction: Incubate strains on Löwenstein‑Jensen medium at 37 °C until visible growth appears.

steps.title: Transfer cells to tube
steps.instruction: Transfer 1–3 inoculation loops of cells into a microcentrifuge tube containing 400 µL TE‑buffer.

steps.title: Heat‑kill bacteria
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube for 20 min at 80 °C in a water bath; verify temperature with a thermometer.

steps.title: Centrifuge and resuspend
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 5 min at 13 000 rcf, discard the supernatant, then add 400 µL TE‑buffer.

steps.title: Lysozyme digestion
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of 10 mg/mL lysozyme, vortex, and incubate at least 1 h at 37 °C (or overnight).

steps.title: SDS‑proteinase treatment
steps.instruction: Add 70 µL of 10 % SDS and 10 µL proteinase, vortex briefly, then incubate 1 h at 60 °C.

steps.title: Add NaCl solution
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of 5 M NaCl to the tube.

steps.title: CTAB precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL CTAB/NaCl mix pre‑warmed at 65 °C, vortex until the mixture turns white, and incubate 10 min at 65 °C.

steps.title: Organic extraction
steps.instruction: Add ~750 µL chloroform/isoamyl alcohol (24:1), vortex 10 s, then centrifuge 15 min at 13 000 rcf at room temperature.

steps.title: Collect aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Transfer the upper aqueous supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: Isopropanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 0.6 × volume (450 µL) isopropanol, mix gently, and incubate 30 min at –20 °C.

steps.title: Pellet DNA (first spin)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 15 min at 13 000 g.

steps.title: First ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Remove most supernatant, add 500 µL cold 70 % ethanol, then centrifuge 15 min at ≈11 000 ×g.

steps.title: Leave residual ethanol
steps.instruction: Discard most supernatant, leaving about 20 µL (≈3 mm height) above the pellet.

steps.title: Second ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL cold 70 % ethanol (from –20 °C freezer), invert tube a few times, then centrifuge 5 min at ≈11 000 ×g.

steps.title: Leave residual ethanol again
steps.instruction: Discard most supernatant, leaving about 20 µL (≈3 mm height) above the pellet.

steps.title: Final short spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 1 min at ≈11 000 ×g.

steps.title: Remove remaining ethanol
steps.instruction: Pipette off the remaining supernatant carefully with a 20 µL pipette.

steps.title: Dry DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the pellet for ≈15 min at room temperature; extend if ethanol remains.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Dissolve the dried pellet in 1X TE buffer, using the volume estimated in step 10.
